01 ABOUT ME

Curiosity, meet hands-on work.

An IT student who learns by building, testing ideas, and asking how a system can work better.

I’m studying Information Technology at the College of Our Lady of Mercy, with practical experience across Android, web, and database projects.

I enjoy shaping an idea into a working interface, then connecting it to the data and logic behind it. My projects have helped me explore everything from patient workflows to small browser games.

Networking and cybersecurity are interests I’m actively developing. I’m looking for opportunities to keep learning with a team and contribute to useful products.
